exemptions: This repository is a CLI/library; endpoint, database, MCP, and UI product surfaces are out of scope for this fix.

contract.intent: Validate the versioned semantic evaluation corpus, adaptive verification, and immutable review-unit reuse, failing closed when required evidence is incomplete.

outcomes.statement: The CLI exposes a deterministic reviewable-file manifest, batch plan, and private SHA/policy-bound manifest without model execution.
A partial batch writes a private artifact bound to the exact PR SHA, policy fingerprint, index, and file manifest; it cannot post to GitHub.
Only every matching, successful batch artifact can consolidate to a publishable review; stale, duplicate, incomplete, or mismatched artifacts fail closed.
HTML, CSS, Markdown, and MDX changes are reviewable rather than silently left outside coverage.
GitHub inline findings explain why a correction is needed, the required change, an acceptance check, and confidence.
The GitHub Action defaults stay within the provider-call ceiling and expose max-calls and max-findings-per-file controls.
CI gives local CLI providers an explicit safe authentication path and fails early when Codex cannot use the selected isolated mode.
Review idempotency fingerprints use the installed package version rather than a stale hardcoded version.
Review state and summary updates inspect bounded comment history and fail closed before posting when history is truncated.
GitHub API and reporter responses have shared size limits, deadlines, and transient GET retry behavior.
Integration coverage exercises Action defaults, authentication routing, pagination overflow, bounded response bodies, and existing provider failures.
The package typechecks, tests, documentation gates, and packs successfully.
Terminal provider authentication failures stop additional provider calls while preserving fail-closed review semantics.
Normal Codex runs execute one bounded provider smoke check before fan-out and fail early on authentication or timeout errors.
A review-wide deadline propagates cancellation to active adapters and prevents queued provider calls from starting after expiry.
The explicit fast profile batches correctness, security, and tests with one vote and no retry, while preserving required-lens fail-closed semantics.
Repeated transient provider failures and terminal provider failures stop unnecessary fan-out and expose skipped-call evidence.
Completed reports expose profile, provider calls, failures, skips, elapsed time, deadline status, and circuit state.
A deterministic, credential-free benchmark proves clean approval, required-lens failure, and deadline fail-closed behavior with machine-readable evidence.
Package metadata, lockfile, public examples, changelog, npm publication, and immutable release tag agree on the current Changesets version.
Changesets creates a reviewable version pull request on main, and only its bot-authored merge can trigger a validated OIDC npm publication and immutable GitHub release without a long-lived npm token.
The public memory configuration creates a bounded repository-local AgentsKit ChatMemory, persists messages, applies retention, and fails closed on malformed records.

Operational state, review cache, feedback, and permanent knowledge use separate schemas and local lifecycles; knowledge accepts only bounded approved rules and never provider transcripts or source payloads.
Only explicitly approved bounded memory rules enter review context, and a live A/B canary proves detection lift without precision or token regression before memory-learning can pass.
The public comment configuration reaches GitHub reporters and controls inline output, summary output, language labels, and detail sections without weakening non-approving fallback behavior.

The exported quality matrix scores every approved review-quality area, blocks any unmeasured or sub-three area, and enforces absolute safety, completeness, inline-comment, stale-artifact, and silent-failure gates.
The quality-matrix CLI evaluates a SHA-bound JSON artifact, compares an optional baseline, writes a private report, and returns exit code 2 for BLOCKED results.

One packaged command owns blocker collection, contract lock, replay, canary, crash-safe batch resume, consolidation, quality reports, safe posting and merge gates, and always emits cycle-summary.json.

Version 2 baseline contracts distinguish synthetic process evidence, real pull-request evidence, and real campaign evidence while representing missing token and duration dimensions as unmeasured rather than zero.
A credential-free command wraps the existing deterministic cycle benchmark in a stable v0.8.0 baseline identity and rejects repository-local study output paths.
Accepted ADRs document the deterministic engine, provider and SCM adapter boundaries, diff-first token strategy, and separated safe learning memory, with explicit trade-offs and PRD references.
Real-run quality matrices and measurements remain local study artifacts and are neither required nor shipped in the npm package.
Versioned campaign and pull-request contracts expose exhaustive terminal outcome sets and reject inconsistent terminal state.
Typed failure contracts distinguish terminal, retryable, replannable, and cancelled dispositions with disposition-specific metadata.
The immutable review identity binds source SHAs, policy, prompt, model, configuration, and package version to a stable fingerprint.
Campaign, pull-request run, review-unit, event, budget, failure, and identity contracts validate and JSON-roundtrip without provider or GitHub access.
Every allowed campaign, pull-request, and review-unit transition is deterministic, immutable, and controlled by one reducer.
Wrong sequence, wrong campaign, skipped stage, duplicate identity, premature completion, and post-terminal events fail closed.
A complete offline review reaches approval and campaign completion through ordered events only.
Replaying the same event log from the same contract produces the identical final state.
Versioned state, event, evidence, and external-effect records commit atomically and an interrupted commit leaves the prior checkpoint readable.
Atomic leases prevent concurrent ownership of the same campaign or pull request and safely replace expired ownership.
Resume deterministically replays the last valid checkpoint and rejects a changed immutable identity.
Completed review units and persisted idempotent external effects are identified and not repeated after resume.
Known providers expose validated structured-output, usage, cancellation, prompt-cache, context, session, timeout, and safe-concurrency metadata.
AgentsKit AdapterFactory remains the model abstraction and its explicit capability hints refine registry policy without a wrapper model interface.
Unknown provider metadata disables unsupported optimizations, leaves limits unknown, and limits concurrency to one.
Review concurrency and timeout defaults derive from capability metadata without provider-name branches.
Timeout, rate-limit, server, authentication, malformed-output, cancellation, and unknown provider failures normalize to explicit retryable, terminal, or cancelled dispositions.
Only retryable provider failures receive bounded exponential backoff with jitter; authentication and cancellation fail without retry.
Provider instability lowers live concurrency without exceeding capability-derived maximums, and sustained success cautiously restores capacity.
Repeated provider instability stops fan-out and, after cooldown, admits exactly one controlled recovery probe.
A failed review unit does not discard successful sibling evidence, and queued work cancels immediately without starting provider execution.
Normalized SCM contracts cover change-request discovery, metadata, complete diffs, review state, inline and summary publication, merge readiness, and revision-locked merge without platform payloads.
A deterministic in-memory SCM fake executes one complete discover-to-merge lifecycle through the public contract.
An adapter lacking a requested capability fails with an explicit typed error, and GitLab remains documented as future work.
CLI and scheduled-cycle GitHub source acquisition, review-state inspection, publication, merge readiness, and merge mutation route through the common SCM adapter.
GitHub request deadlines, bounded reads and history, safe raw-content hosts, redaction, idempotency markers, complete-check evidence, and advisory fallback remain enforced.
Public inline and summary reporter APIs preserve rendering, language, sections, and non-approving fallback behavior through adapter-backed wrappers.
Normal and administrative merges are revision-locked and fail closed unless draft, mergeability, check-run completeness, checks, and commit status are acceptable.
One validated project configuration drives provider-neutral discovery and includes every discovered change request exactly once in stable order.
Dependabot, configured authors, drafts, forks, closed requests, and previously reviewed SHA-policy pairs receive explicit deterministic eligibility outcomes.
Every eligible change request receives complete diff, changed-file, source-coverage, and budget preflight evidence before execution.
Campaign preflight collects all discoverable blockers without model analysis or worktree creation and always emits a machine-readable report.
Every discovered pull request appears exactly once with a schema-validated terminal outcome, including skipped and preflight-blocked requests.
Campaign execution never exceeds configured concurrency and one pull-request failure does not prevent independent work from reaching a terminal outcome by default.
Atomic leased campaign checkpoints reuse terminal work and safely requeue an interrupted in-flight pull request without duplicate completion.
Complete, partial, blocked, and cancelled campaign outcomes are derived by deterministic code without an LLM orchestration decision.
One normal context pack uses one initial structured provider call across every enabled review dimension.
Review results explicitly report enabled and completed categories, and a missing required category makes the result incomplete and non-approving.
The fixed quality corpus preserves every expected detection through multidimensional analysis.
Automated evidence shows fewer provider calls and tokens than the equivalent seven-lens baseline.
Eligible changed hunks remain reviewable when the complete file exceeds the former per-file prompt limit.
A context pack contains one numbered changed-source projection and never repeats the unified patch beside it.
Small directly related source and test files share one deterministic context pack without duplicate file coverage.
Adjacent-line and related-file expansion is explicitly configured, bounded, and recorded in plan and review evidence.
AgentsKit compileBudget measures every context pack including system prompt and tool schema and rejects oversized packs before provider execution.
Context-pack risk classification is deterministic and makes no provider call.
Security, authorization, credential, migration, IO, repository-control, and public-contract evidence selects elevated specialized review depth.
Documentation and generated-only context packs follow explicit low-risk single-analysis policy.
Every context-pack plan and completed result records risk level, contributing evidence, and specialized categories.
Critical security defects preserve the approved fixed-corpus detection level under risk-based specialization.
A versioned evaluation corpus exercises known-positive and clean cases and measures detection, precision, severity, actionability, and coverage against the current review engine.
The quality matrix cannot pass when any required lens execution is missing, even if file coverage is complete.
Multiple findings share bounded skeptical-verification requests without duplicating source context.
Medium, high, and blocker findings receive deterministic vote depth based on severity and confidence, with a third vote only after configured disagreement.
Missing or malformed required verification evidence makes the review incomplete and cannot create an approved review or a verified finding.
The fixed quality corpus preserves expected findings while using fewer verification provider calls than one request per finding and vote.
Completed review units are keyed by source, diff, base, policy, prompt, model, and relevant knowledge identities.
An identical second execution reuses validated cache entries without provider calls and emits cache-hit and saved-token metrics.
Relevant identity changes, corrupt records, stale records, and unvalidated records cannot be reused as review evidence.
Cache records preserve source provenance, token usage, validation status, and are replaced atomically without raw source content.
Campaign, pull-request, context-pack, analysis, and verification budgets are schema-validated with explicit output and critical-verification reserves.
Every provider request reserves its estimated input and output capacity before execution, including concurrent and retry attempts.
A pull-request budget cannot consume the campaign reserve, and child scope call/token limits cannot exceed their parent capacity.
Review evidence and quality inputs preserve input, cached-input, output, reasoning, memory, retry, provider-call, and wall-clock dimensions, leaving unsupported dimensions explicitly unavailable.
Impossible minimum budgets fail during provider-free planning without creating a worktree or starting a provider request.
